pool.r0000:
Make-derived public Test22 UI/HUD/text profiles, including the current rr recipe.

The real R21 and Test22 assignments, current CH2 literal recipe and public
asset fallbacks feed Make for UI, bridge, ID and message objects. Debug records are omitted
consistently. No linked game, asset package or KOS library patch is built.
pool.r0082:
Price actual dynamic instruction traces with the repository's hwsim model.

Perfect caches, no memory/bus/SQ/DMA events and no final completion drain.
This is a synthetic CPU scheduling comparison, never hardware time or FPS.
pool.r0085:
Observe real opcode data accesses without inventing cache misses.

Instruction fetches are excluded; PC-relative literal loads are data loads.
The fixture maps cached RAM at low synthetic addresses, which become the
0x8c000000 alias only for the pipeline-model ELF. Distinct 32-byte lines are
working-set/touch counts, not measured fills or hardware bus transactions.

r0086.scope: PREF requests observed separately; not demand loads, fills or guaranteed useful transfers

pool.r0117: Weighted isolated probe deltas at synthetic frequencies, warm-I perfect-D; one drawn tick and no skips. Fault arm assumes matching bin is last of 32. Add unpriced renderer tags, formatting/serial, hardware timer/IRQ and memory wait states.
